## 1. Project goal and data sources

PBS Utah wants to identify current non-major donors who are likely to reach
$1,200 or more in annual giving. The immediate outcome is conversion within 12
months; if the historical data supports it, the longer-term outcome will be
conversion within 3-5 years. This analysis uses constituent, payment, legacy
giving, soft-credit, campaign, Passport viewing, cultivation, and
officer-portfolio data.

The purpose of this EDA is to assess data quality, coverage, and useful
patterns before building a time-based prediction model. All records in this
release are synthetic, so no row represents a real constituent or gift.

```{r}
#| label: list-source-files

# This check makes the expected source files explicit before any analysis.
expected_files <- c(
  "constituents_w_memberships.csv",
  "unite_payments.csv",
  "team_approach_legacy_payments.csv",
  "soft_credits.csv",
  "campaign_codes.csv",
  "campaign_members.csv",
  "passport_viewing.csv",
  "cultivation.csv",
  "officer_portfolios.csv"
)

tibble(file = expected_files, exists = file.exists(file.path(data_dir, expected_files)))
```

## 2. Data inventory and grain/key documentation

These datasets have different grains, including one row per constituent,
payment, solicitation, or constituent-year-genre. They should not be joined at
the raw-row level because doing so can duplicate records. Transactional datasets will later be aggregated to a common donor-fiscal-year grain before modeling.

| File | Row represents / type | Unique key and links | Rows / unique constituents | Coverage | Data-quality findings |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `constituents_w_memberships.csv` | One constituent snapshot; attribute table | Constituent ID; referenced by most datasets | 196,167 / 196,167 | End-of-data snapshot; no dates | No missing or duplicate IDs; no duplicate rows; ages are 0–120. |
| `unite_payments.csv` | One payment; transaction table | payment_id; donor_id → Constituent ID; marketing_code → campaign code | 1,722,698 / 71,643 IDs (71,642 matched constituents + SYN-ORPHAN) | FY2021–FY2026, 2020-07-01 to 2026-06-30 | IDs and rows are unique. donor_id is SYN-ORPHAN in 33,733 rows. 1,086 zero-dollar payments need review. |
| `team_approach_legacy_payments.csv` | One legacy gift/payment; transaction table | No unique transaction ID. ta_account_id is a repeating household account; constituent_id_1–_7 → Constituent ID | 1,202,857 / 109,284 linked constituents | 1983-07-26 to 2020-06-28, pre-FY2021 | No exact duplicate rows; all amounts positive. 216,128 rows have no linked constituent, which is an allowed legacy-data exception. |
| `soft_credits.csv` | One soft credit; transaction table | Credit ID; Soft Credit Constituent ID → Constituent ID | 4,145 / 3,028 IDs (3,027 matched + SYN-ORPHAN) | FY2021–FY2026, 2020-07-01 to 2026-06-29 | 79 exact duplicate rows / repeated Credit IDs; 79 SYN-ORPHAN recipients; 34 zero-dollar credits need review. |
| `campaign_codes.csv` | One marketing/campaign code; reference table | Marketing Code; used by campaign members and payments | 29,249 / n.a. | No transaction date; includes initiative fields | No missing or duplicate keys or rows. All records are marked Active and Solicitation. |
| `campaign_members.csv` | One constituent solicitation/campaign-membership record; workflow/operational table | No unique key. constituent_id → Constituent ID; marketing_code → Marketing Code | 5,233,404 / 181,680 | FY2021–FY2026; campaign markers 2020-07-01 to 2025-07-01; responses through 2026-06-30 | Links are complete and valid. 56,689 exact duplicate rows; constituent/code pairs repeat in 58,786 rows, sometimes valid under the documented solicitation rules. |
| `passport_viewing.csv` | One constituent × fiscal year × genre viewing record; behavioral attribute table | Composite constituent_id + fiscal_year + genre; constituent ID → Constituent ID | 444,741 / 70,515 | FY2021–FY2026 | Composite key is unique; all IDs link; no duplicate rows; viewing counts are positive and watch percentages are within 0–1. |
| `cultivation.csv` | One constituent-year portfolio assignment; workflow/operational table | Composite synthetic_id + fiscal_year; IDs → Constituent ID and portfolio_id → officer portfolios | 4,000 / 2,398 | FY2022–FY2025 | Composite key is unique; all links and binary flags are valid; no duplicate rows. |
| `officer_portfolios.csv` | One officer portfolio; workflow/reference table | portfolio_id; referenced by cultivation | 8 / n.a. | Rollout FYs: 2023–2026 | No missing or duplicate keys or rows. |

**Key implications:** Payments, soft credits, campaign memberships, and Passport viewing are one-to-many relative to constituents and cannot be raw-joined without duplicating records. The major issues requiring handling before modeling are exact duplicates in soft credits and campaign members, SYN-ORPHAN IDs, and zero-dollar payment/credit rows. Current constituent attributes are end-of-data snapshots and will need time-aware handling later to prevent leakage.

## 3. Raw data quality checks

### Loading and structural checks

The following code loads the raw files and verifies their basic structure before any transformations or joins. This creates a compact baseline for checking that each expected file is readable and has the expected scale.

```{r}
#| label: loading-and-structural-checks

# Standardize names immediately after import so all later code can use
# consistent snake_case column names.
constituents <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "constituents_w_memberships.csv"),
                         show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names()
unite_payments <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "unite_payments.csv"),
                           show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names()
legacy_payments <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "team_approach_legacy_payments.csv"),
                            show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names()
soft_credits <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "soft_credits.csv"),
                         show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names()
campaign_codes <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "campaign_codes.csv"),
                           show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names()
campaign_members <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "campaign_members.csv"),
                             show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names()
passport_viewing <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "passport_viewing.csv"),
                             show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names()
cultivation <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "cultivation.csv"),
                        show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names()
officer_portfolios <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "officer_portfolios.csv"),
                               show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names()

raw_data <- list(
  "constituents_w_memberships.csv" = constituents,
  "unite_payments.csv" = unite_payments,
  "team_approach_legacy_payments.csv" = legacy_payments,
  "soft_credits.csv" = soft_credits,
  "campaign_codes.csv" = campaign_codes,
  "campaign_members.csv" = campaign_members,
  "passport_viewing.csv" = passport_viewing,
  "cultivation.csv" = cultivation,
  "officer_portfolios.csv" = officer_portfolios
)

structural_summary <- imap_dfr(raw_data, ~ tibble(
  file_name = .y,
  total_rows = nrow(.x),
  total_columns = ncol(.x),
  exact_duplicate_rows = nrow(.x) - nrow(distinct(.x)),
  total_missing_values = sum(is.na(.x))
))

knitr::kable(structural_summary, format = "pipe")
```

This structural check is designed to identify unexpected file sizes, schema
differences, exact duplicate records, and missing-data volume before detailed
quality checks begin. It does not make cleaning decisions or interpret any
findings.

### Missing-data checks

Missingness must be assessed by column because it can reflect unavailable
information, an unknown value, or a valid absence of activity.

```{r}
#| label: missing-data-checks

missing_data_summary <- imap_dfr(raw_data, function(data, file) {
  map_dfr(names(data), function(column) {
    values <- data[[column]]

    tibble(
      file_name = file,
      column_name = column,
      missing_na = sum(is.na(values)),
      percent_missing = 100 * mean(is.na(values)),
      blank_strings = if (is.character(values)) {
        sum(!is.na(values) & trimws(values) == "")
      } else {
        0L
      }
    )
  })
}) |>
  filter(missing_na > 0 | blank_strings > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(percent_missing))

knitr::kable(missing_data_summary, format = "pipe", digits = 1)
```

### Key and duplicate checks

Repeated activity is not always a duplicate: a donor can have many payments or
solicitations. Duplicates must therefore be evaluated using each dataset's
documented key.

```{r}
#| label: key-quality-checks

key_specs <- list(
  constituents = c("constituent_id"),
  unite_payments = c("payment_id"),
  campaign_codes = c("marketing_code"),
  passport_viewing = c("constituent_id", "fiscal_year", "genre"),
  cultivation = c("synthetic_id", "fiscal_year"),
  officer_portfolios = c("portfolio_id")
)

key_quality_summary <- imap_dfr(key_specs, function(key_columns, dataset_name) {
  data <- get(dataset_name)
  missing_key <- reduce(map(key_columns, function(column) {
    values <- data[[column]]
    is.na(values) | (is.character(values) & trimws(values) == "")
  }), `|`)

  valid_keys <- data |>
    filter(!missing_key) |>
    select(all_of(key_columns))

  duplicate_key_rows <- valid_keys |>
    group_by(across(all_of(key_columns))) |>
    summarise(rows_per_key = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(rows_per_key > 1) |>
    summarise(rows_in_duplicated_keys = sum(rows_per_key)) |>
    pull(rows_in_duplicated_keys)

  tibble(
    dataset = dataset_name,
    total_rows = nrow(data),
    rows_with_missing_key = sum(missing_key),
    distinct_keys = nrow(distinct(valid_keys)),
    rows_in_duplicated_keys = replace_na(duplicate_key_rows, 0L)
  )
})

knitr::kable(key_quality_summary, format = "pipe")
```

```{r}
#| label: exact-duplicate-row-checks

exact_duplicate_summary <- imap_dfr(raw_data, ~ tibble(
  file_name = .y,
  exact_duplicate_rows = nrow(.x) - nrow(distinct(.x))
))

knitr::kable(exact_duplicate_summary, format = "pipe")
```

### Relationship and link checks

These checks verify whether foreign keys can be linked to their documented
parent tables before later aggregation. An unmatched ID does not automatically
mean an error because the synthetic data includes documented `SYN-ORPHAN` and
legacy-data exceptions.

```{r}
#| label: relationship-and-link-checks

relationship_specs <- tribble(
  ~child_dataset, ~child_key, ~parent_dataset, ~parent_key,
  "unite_payments", "donor_id", "constituents", "constituent_id",
  "soft_credits", "soft_credit_constituent_id", "constituents", "constituent_id",
  "campaign_members", "constituent_id", "constituents", "constituent_id",
  "campaign_members", "marketing_code", "campaign_codes", "marketing_code",
  "unite_payments", "marketing_code", "campaign_codes", "marketing_code",
  "passport_viewing", "constituent_id", "constituents", "constituent_id",
  "cultivation", "synthetic_id", "constituents", "constituent_id",
  "cultivation", "portfolio_id", "officer_portfolios", "portfolio_id"
)

relationship_quality_summary <- pmap_dfr(
  relationship_specs,
  function(child_dataset, child_key, parent_dataset, parent_key) {
    child_data <- get(child_dataset)
    parent_data <- get(parent_dataset)

    child_ids <- child_data |>
      transmute(foreign_key = as.character(.data[[child_key]]))
    parent_ids <- parent_data |>
      transmute(parent_key_value = as.character(.data[[parent_key]])) |>
      distinct()
    unmatched_ids <- child_ids |>
      anti_join(parent_ids, by = c("foreign_key" = "parent_key_value"))

    tibble(
      child_dataset_foreign_key = paste0(child_dataset, "$", child_key),
      parent_dataset_key = paste0(parent_dataset, "$", parent_key),
      total_child_rows = nrow(child_data),
      unmatched_child_rows = nrow(unmatched_ids),
      distinct_unmatched_ids = n_distinct(unmatched_ids$foreign_key)
    )
  }
)

knitr::kable(relationship_quality_summary, format = "pipe")
```

```{r}
#| label: legacy-payment-link-checks

legacy_constituent_columns <- paste0("constituent_id_", 1:7)
legacy_link_matrix <- legacy_payments |>
  select(all_of(legacy_constituent_columns)) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) |>
  as.matrix()

legacy_has_link <- rowSums(
  !is.na(legacy_link_matrix) & trimws(legacy_link_matrix) != ""
) > 0
legacy_ids <- legacy_link_matrix[
  !is.na(legacy_link_matrix) & trimws(legacy_link_matrix) != ""
]
constituent_ids <- as.character(constituents$constituent_id)

legacy_link_summary <- tibble(
  total_legacy_rows = nrow(legacy_payments),
  rows_with_no_linked_constituent = sum(!legacy_has_link),
  percent_rows_with_no_linked_constituent = 100 * mean(!legacy_has_link),
  nonmissing_legacy_constituent_ids = length(legacy_ids),
  unmatched_legacy_constituent_ids = sum(!legacy_ids %in% constituent_ids)
)

knitr::kable(legacy_link_summary, format = "pipe", digits = 1)
```

### Value and date-range checks

These checks identify values outside plausible ranges and describe highly
skewed transaction amounts. An outlier is not automatically an error.

```{r}
#| label: transaction-amount-checks

amount_specs <- tribble(
  ~dataset, ~column,
  "unite_payments", "payment_amount",
  "legacy_payments", "payment_amount",
  "soft_credits", "credit_amount"
)

transaction_amount_summary <- pmap_dfr(amount_specs, function(dataset, column) {
  values <- get(dataset)[[column]]
  percentiles <- quantile(
    values,
    probs = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.95),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    names = FALSE
  )

  tibble(
    amount_field = paste0(dataset, "$", column),
    missing_values = sum(is.na(values)),
    zero_values = sum(values == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    negative_values = sum(values < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    minimum = min(values, na.rm = TRUE),
    percentile_25 = percentiles[1],
    median = percentiles[2],
    percentile_75 = percentiles[3],
    percentile_95 = percentiles[4],
    maximum = max(values, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
})

knitr::kable(transaction_amount_summary, format = "pipe", digits = 2)
```

```{r}
#| label: range-and-validity-checks

summarise_range_validity <- function(values, field, lower_bound, upper_bound) {
  tibble(
    field = field,
    missing_values = sum(is.na(values)),
    minimum = min(values, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum = max(values, na.rm = TRUE),
    count_below_lower_bound = sum(values < lower_bound, na.rm = TRUE),
    count_above_upper_bound = sum(values > upper_bound, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

range_validity_summary <- bind_rows(
  summarise_range_validity(constituents$age, "constituents$age", 0, 120),
  summarise_range_validity(passport_viewing$titles_viewed,
                           "passport_viewing$titles_viewed", 0, Inf),
  summarise_range_validity(passport_viewing$mean_percent_watched,
                           "passport_viewing$mean_percent_watched", 0, 1)
)

knitr::kable(range_validity_summary, format = "pipe", digits = 2)
```

```{r}
#| label: date-range-checks

date_specs <- tribble(
  ~dataset, ~column,
  "unite_payments", "credit_date",
  "legacy_payments", "gift_date",
  "soft_credits", "credit_date",
  "campaign_members", "campaign_start_date",
  "campaign_members", "responded_date"
)

date_range_summary <- pmap_dfr(date_specs, function(dataset, column) {
  values <- as.Date(get(dataset)[[column]])
  nonmissing_dates <- values[!is.na(values)]

  tibble(
    date_field = paste0(dataset, "$", column),
    missing_values = sum(is.na(values)),
    minimum_date = if (length(nonmissing_dates) > 0) min(nonmissing_dates) else as.Date(NA),
    maximum_date = if (length(nonmissing_dates) > 0) max(nonmissing_dates) else as.Date(NA)
  )
})

knitr::kable(date_range_summary, format = "pipe")
```

### Summary of data quality findings
Exact duplicate rows occurred only in soft_credits (79 rows) and campaign_members (56,689 rows). Repeated campaign memberships are not automatically duplicates because a constituent can receive more than one solicitation.
Missingness is concentrated in fields that are either unavailable in this synthetic release or structurally blank. Several University degree/employment fields, legacy descriptive and premium fields, and campaign_description are entirely missing. Campaign response_type and responded_date are missing for most records because most solicitations did not receive a response. Spouse and marital-status fields are also largely incomplete, while only two age values are missing. The constituent table is an end-of-data snapshot, so its fields will require time-aware handling later to avoid using information that would not have been available at a historical prediction date.
Most foreign-key relationships are complete. The unmatched payment and soft-credit constituent records use the documented SYN-ORPHAN placeholder and cannot be linked to an individual donor. One marketing code accounts for 1,225 Unite payment rows that do not match campaign_codes and should be investigated before modeling. Legacy payments also include documented records with no linked constituent. Amounts contain no negative values, but Unite payments include 1,086 zero-dollar rows and soft credits include 34; these require a documented treatment before annual giving is calculated. Transaction amounts are highly right-skewed, with large gifts retained as plausible outliers unless later review identifies an error. All checked dates and Passport viewing ranges were valid.


## 4. Cleaning decisions

The raw imported tables remain unchanged. The following rules will be applied
only when creating analysis-ready copies.

| Issue | Decision | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Exact duplicate `soft_credits` rows | Retain one copy of each exact duplicate before later aggregation. | Duplicate credits would overstate individual giving. |
| Exact duplicate `campaign_members` rows | Retain one copy of each exact duplicate. | Exact repeats do not represent additional solicitation activity. |
| Non-identical repeated campaign memberships | Retain. | A constituent may legitimately receive multiple solicitations. |
| `SYN-ORPHAN` payment and soft-credit records | Exclude from the individual-level modeling dataset but quantify as a data-coverage limitation. | They cannot be linked to a constituent. |
| Zero-dollar payments and soft credits | Retain in raw audit tables but exclude from annual giving-dollar totals. | They do not contribute to giving amount. |
| Negative amounts | No action required. | None were found. |
| Fields that are 100% missing | Exclude from future feature creation. | They contain no information. |
| Structurally missing campaign response fields | Do not impute. | Missing `responded_date` and `response_type` generally indicate no recorded response. |
| Missing Passport records | Do not treat as zero viewing. | Preserve missingness and coverage as a separate concept. |
| Missing age and other partially missing constituent fields | Retain as missing for now. | Any model imputation must later be fit using training data only. |
| End-of-data constituent snapshot fields | Do not use directly as historical predictors unless a time-valid version can be created. | They could introduce data leakage. |
| Unite payments with an unmatched marketing code | Retain the payment for giving totals; treat campaign information as unknown unless the code can be mapped later. | The payment remains valid for giving analysis. |
| Large gifts | Retain. | They are plausible donor behavior, not demonstrated errors. |

The next subsection applies these rules to create analysis-ready copies while preserving the raw tables.

### Creating analysis-ready copies

The following code creates new analysis-ready objects while preserving all raw
objects for audit. These copies apply only the documented record-level rules;
they do not aggregate transactions, impute values, or create modeling features.

```{r}
#| label: create-analysis-ready-copies

campaign_members_analysis <- campaign_members |>
  distinct()

soft_credits_deduplicated <- soft_credits |>
  distinct()

soft_credits_analysis <- soft_credits_deduplicated |>
  filter(is.na(soft_credit_constituent_id) |
           soft_credit_constituent_id != "SYN-ORPHAN") |>
  mutate(positive_amount = coalesce(credit_amount > 0, FALSE))

unite_payments_analysis <- unite_payments |>
  filter(is.na(donor_id) | donor_id != "SYN-ORPHAN") |>
  mutate(
    positive_amount = coalesce(payment_amount > 0, FALSE),
    campaign_code_matched = marketing_code %in% campaign_codes$marketing_code
  )

constituents_analysis <- constituents
legacy_payments_analysis <- legacy_payments
passport_viewing_analysis <- passport_viewing
cultivation_analysis <- cultivation
officer_portfolios_analysis <- officer_portfolios
campaign_codes_analysis <- campaign_codes
```

```{r}
#| label: analysis-ready-copy-audit

analysis_ready_audit <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    dataset = "campaign_members",
    raw_rows = nrow(campaign_members),
    rows_after_exact_deduplication = nrow(campaign_members_analysis),
    syn_orphan_rows_excluded = NA_integer_,
    zero_dollar_rows_retained_and_flagged = NA_integer_,
    final_analysis_ready_rows = nrow(campaign_members_analysis)
  ),
  tibble(
    dataset = "soft_credits",
    raw_rows = nrow(soft_credits),
    rows_after_exact_deduplication = nrow(soft_credits_deduplicated),
    syn_orphan_rows_excluded = sum(
      soft_credits_deduplicated$soft_credit_constituent_id == "SYN-ORPHAN",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    zero_dollar_rows_retained_and_flagged = sum(
      soft_credits_analysis$credit_amount == 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    final_analysis_ready_rows = nrow(soft_credits_analysis)
  ),
  tibble(
    dataset = "unite_payments",
    raw_rows = nrow(unite_payments),
    rows_after_exact_deduplication = NA_integer_,
    syn_orphan_rows_excluded = sum(unite_payments$donor_id == "SYN-ORPHAN",
                                   na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_dollar_rows_retained_and_flagged = sum(
      unite_payments_analysis$payment_amount == 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    final_analysis_ready_rows = nrow(unite_payments_analysis)
  )
)

knitr::kable(analysis_ready_audit, format = "pipe")
```

## 5. Descriptive patterns in giving and engagement

### Giving patterns over time

Fiscal-year trends describe the available giving history but do not yet combine
all giving sources into the final donor-level modeling dataset.

```{r}
#| label: giving-patterns-over-time

fiscal_year_from_date <- function(date) {
  year(date) + if_else(month(date) >= 7, 1L, 0L)
}

unite_payments_fy <- unite_payments_analysis |>
  filter(positive_amount) |>
  mutate(fiscal_year = paste0("FY", fiscal_year_from_date(credit_date))) |>
  group_by(fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    total_payment_dollars = sum(payment_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    number_of_payments = n(),
    distinct_linked_donors = n_distinct(donor_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(fiscal_year)

soft_credits_fy <- soft_credits_analysis |>
  filter(positive_amount) |>
  mutate(fiscal_year = paste0("FY", fiscal_year_from_date(credit_date))) |>
  group_by(fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    total_credited_dollars = sum(credit_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    number_of_soft_credit_records = n(),
    distinct_linked_constituents = n_distinct(soft_credit_constituent_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(fiscal_year)

knitr::kable(unite_payments_fy, format = "pipe", digits = 2)
knitr::kable(soft_credits_fy, format = "pipe", digits = 2)
```

### Campaign activity and response patterns

Campaign-membership records represent solicitations, not unique donors or
gifts. A constituent can appear more than once, so both solicitation volume and
distinct constituents should be reported.

```{r}
#| label: campaign-activity-and-response-summaries

campaign_code_features <- campaign_codes_analysis |>
  select(marketing_code, communication_method, campaign_type, activity_type)

campaign_activity <- campaign_members_analysis |>
  mutate(
    fiscal_year = paste0("FY", fiscal_year_from_date(campaign_start_date))
  ) |>
  left_join(
    campaign_code_features,
    by = "marketing_code",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

campaign_fy_summary <- campaign_activity |>
  group_by(fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    solicitation_records = n(),
    distinct_solicited_constituents = n_distinct(constituent_id),
    responses = sum(responded == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    response_rate = mean(responded, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(fiscal_year)

campaign_method_summary <- campaign_activity |>
  group_by(communication_method) |>
  summarise(
    solicitation_records = n(),
    distinct_solicited_constituents = n_distinct(constituent_id),
    responses = sum(responded == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    response_rate = mean(responded, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(response_rate))

knitr::kable(
  mutate(campaign_fy_summary,
         response_rate = scales::percent(response_rate, accuracy = 0.1)),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(
  mutate(campaign_method_summary,
         response_rate = scales::percent(response_rate, accuracy = 0.1)),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

### Passport viewing coverage and engagement

A missing Passport viewing record does not necessarily mean no engagement: it
may reflect no linked account, no consent, or no viewing activity. Therefore,
viewing coverage must be reported before interpreting behavior.

```{r}
#| label: passport-coverage-and-genre-summaries

passport_constituent_year <- passport_viewing_analysis |>
  group_by(fiscal_year, constituent_id) |>
  summarise(
    titles_viewed = sum(titles_viewed, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_percent_watched = median(mean_percent_watched, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

passport_coverage_fy <- passport_constituent_year |>
  group_by(fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    constituents_with_viewing = n_distinct(constituent_id),
    total_constituents = nrow(constituents_analysis),
    passport_coverage = constituents_with_viewing / total_constituents,
    total_viewing_records = sum(
      passport_viewing_analysis$fiscal_year == first(fiscal_year),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    total_titles_viewed = sum(titles_viewed, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_titles_per_viewing_constituent = median(titles_viewed, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_percent_watched_per_constituent_year = median(
      median_percent_watched,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(fiscal_year)

passport_genre_summary <- passport_viewing_analysis |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    total_titles_viewed = sum(titles_viewed, na.rm = TRUE),
    distinct_viewing_constituents = n_distinct(constituent_id),
    median_percent_watched = median(mean_percent_watched, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  slice_max(total_titles_viewed, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  arrange(desc(total_titles_viewed))

knitr::kable(
  passport_coverage_fy |>
    mutate(
      across(c(constituents_with_viewing, total_constituents,
               total_viewing_records, total_titles_viewed,
               median_titles_per_viewing_constituent), scales::comma),
      passport_coverage = scales::percent(passport_coverage, accuracy = 0.1),
      median_percent_watched_per_constituent_year = scales::percent(
        median_percent_watched_per_constituent_year,
        accuracy = 0.1
      )
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(
  passport_genre_summary |>
    mutate(
      total_titles_viewed = scales::comma(total_titles_viewed),
      distinct_viewing_constituents = scales::comma(distinct_viewing_constituents),
      median_percent_watched = scales::percent(median_percent_watched,
                                                accuracy = 0.1)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

### Cultivation and portfolio context

Cultivation fields describe staff workflow and possible intervention, not
natural donor behavior. They will not be used as standard predictive features
because selection or contact may be influenced by staff judgment.

## 6. Building the donor–fiscal-year dataset

### Annual giving base

The model needs one record per constituent per fiscal year. This first step
creates annual giving from positive Unite payments and positive soft credits.
Legacy payments will be handled separately because they are household-level and
predate FY2021.

```{r}
#| label: annual-giving-base

positive_unite_payments <- unite_payments_analysis |>
  filter(positive_amount) |>
  mutate(fiscal_year = paste0("FY", fiscal_year_from_date(credit_date)))

positive_soft_credits <- soft_credits_analysis |>
  filter(positive_amount) |>
  mutate(fiscal_year = paste0("FY", fiscal_year_from_date(credit_date)))

direct_payment_transactions <- positive_unite_payments |>
  transmute(
    constituent_id = as.character(donor_id),
    fiscal_year,
    gift_credit_date = credit_date,
    amount = payment_amount,
    source = "direct_payment"
  )

soft_credit_transactions <- positive_soft_credits |>
  transmute(
    constituent_id = as.character(soft_credit_constituent_id),
    fiscal_year,
    gift_credit_date = credit_date,
    amount = credit_amount,
    source = "soft_credit"
  )

constituent_giving_transactions <- bind_rows(
  direct_payment_transactions,
  soft_credit_transactions
)

donor_fiscal_year_giving <- constituent_giving_transactions |>
  group_by(constituent_id, fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    annual_giving = sum(amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    direct_payment_dollars = sum(amount[source == "direct_payment"], na.rm = TRUE),
    soft_credit_dollars = sum(amount[source == "soft_credit"], na.rm = TRUE),
    direct_payment_count = sum(source == "direct_payment"),
    soft_credit_count = sum(source == "soft_credit"),
    largest_gift = max(amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_gift_date = min(gift_credit_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_gift_date = max(gift_credit_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: annual-giving-base-audit

annual_giving_base_audit <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    metric = "Positive Unite payments retained",
    rows = nrow(positive_unite_payments),
    dollars = sum(positive_unite_payments$payment_amount, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  tibble(
    metric = "Positive soft credits retained",
    rows = nrow(soft_credit_transactions),
    dollars = sum(soft_credit_transactions$amount, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  tibble(
    metric = "Final combined constituent-giving transactions",
    rows = nrow(constituent_giving_transactions),
    dollars = NA_real_
  ),
  tibble(
    metric = "Final donor-fiscal-year records",
    rows = nrow(donor_fiscal_year_giving),
    dollars = NA_real_
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  annual_giving_base_audit |>
    mutate(rows = scales::comma(rows),
           dollars = if_else(is.na(dollars), NA_character_,
                             scales::dollar(dollars))),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

Direct payments and soft credits are retained as separate credit sources.
`designation_detail_id` is not used as a transaction-level deduplication key
because it can occur on many payment records. This analysis does not attempt to
calculate station revenue by summing the two sources. Organization records will
remain until people and organizations can be identified separately.

### Eligible donor-year panel and major-donor status

An eligible donor is a constituent with at least one positive, linked PBS Utah
giving record during the available FY2021–FY2026 period. The model will later
exclude donors who are already major donors at the prediction date. This
definition should be confirmed with PBS Utah before deployment.

```{r}
#| label: eligible-donor-year-panel

eligible_donors <- donor_fiscal_year_giving |>
  distinct(constituent_id)

observed_fiscal_year_bounds <- donor_fiscal_year_giving |>
  transmute(fiscal_year_number = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(fiscal_year, "FY"))) |>
  summarise(
    first_fiscal_year = min(fiscal_year_number),
    last_fiscal_year = max(fiscal_year_number)
  )

observed_fiscal_years <- paste0(
  "FY",
  seq(observed_fiscal_year_bounds$first_fiscal_year,
      observed_fiscal_year_bounds$last_fiscal_year)
)

donor_fiscal_year_panel <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  constituent_id = eligible_donors$constituent_id,
  fiscal_year = observed_fiscal_years
) |>
  left_join(donor_fiscal_year_giving, by = c("constituent_id", "fiscal_year")) |>
  mutate(
    annual_giving = replace_na(annual_giving, 0),
    direct_payment_dollars = replace_na(direct_payment_dollars, 0),
    soft_credit_dollars = replace_na(soft_credit_dollars, 0),
    direct_payment_count = replace_na(direct_payment_count, 0L),
    soft_credit_count = replace_na(soft_credit_count, 0L),
    largest_gift = replace_na(largest_gift, 0),
    gave_this_year = annual_giving > 0,
    is_major_donor = annual_giving >= 1200,
    giving_tier = case_when(
      annual_giving == 0 ~ "No giving",
      annual_giving < 1200 ~ "Under $1,200",
      annual_giving < 2000 ~ "$1,200–$1,999",
      annual_giving < 5000 ~ "$2,000–$4,999",
      annual_giving < 10000 ~ "$5,000–$9,999",
      annual_giving < 15000 ~ "$10,000–$14,999",
      TRUE ~ "$15,000+"
    ),
    giving_tier = factor(
      giving_tier,
      levels = c(
        "No giving", "Under $1,200", "$1,200–$1,999", "$2,000–$4,999",
        "$5,000–$9,999", "$10,000–$14,999", "$15,000+"
      )
    )
  )

donor_fiscal_year_summary <- donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  group_by(fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    eligible_donors = n_distinct(constituent_id),
    donors_who_gave = sum(gave_this_year),
    major_donors = sum(is_major_donor),
    major_donor_percentage = major_donors / eligible_donors,
    total_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving, na.rm = TRUE),
    major_donor_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving[is_major_donor], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(fiscal_year)

knitr::kable(
  donor_fiscal_year_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(eligible_donors, donors_who_gave, major_donors), scales::comma),
      major_donor_percentage = scales::percent(major_donor_percentage,
                                                accuracy = 0.1),
      across(c(total_annual_giving, major_donor_annual_giving), scales::dollar)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: eligible-donor-year-panel-plots

ggplot(donor_fiscal_year_summary,
       aes(x = fiscal_year, y = major_donors, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Major-donor count by fiscal year",
    x = "Fiscal year",
    y = "Major donors"
  )

donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  count(fiscal_year, giving_tier, name = "donors") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fiscal_year, y = donors, fill = giving_tier)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Eligible donor counts by giving tier and fiscal year",
    x = "Fiscal year",
    y = "Eligible donors",
    fill = "Giving tier"
  )
```

### Individual versus organization eligibility check

The constituent table may contain both people and organizations. Because this
project is intended to rank individual major-donor prospects, entity type must
be understood before finalizing the eligible population.

```{r}
#| label: individual-versus-organization-type-checks

constituent_type_frequency <- bind_rows(
  constituents_analysis |>
    filter(!is.na(primary_constituent_type),
           trimws(primary_constituent_type) != "") |>
    count(primary_constituent_type, name = "constituents") |>
    mutate(type_field = "primary_constituent_type",
           type_value = primary_constituent_type) |>
    select(type_field, type_value, constituents),
  constituents_analysis |>
    filter(!is.na(constituent_type), trimws(constituent_type) != "") |>
    count(constituent_type, name = "constituents") |>
    mutate(type_field = "constituent_type", type_value = constituent_type) |>
    select(type_field, type_value, constituents)
) |>
  arrange(type_field, desc(constituents))

organization_pattern <- regex(
  "organization|foundation|business|corporation|trust|estate",
  ignore_case = TRUE
)

potential_organization_records <- constituents_analysis |>
  mutate(
    primary_constituent_type = as.character(primary_constituent_type),
    constituent_type = as.character(constituent_type)
  ) |>
  filter(
    str_detect(coalesce(primary_constituent_type, ""), organization_pattern) |
      str_detect(coalesce(constituent_type, ""), organization_pattern)
  ) |>
  select(constituent_id, primary_constituent_type, constituent_type)

knitr::kable(
  constituent_type_frequency |>
    mutate(constituents = scales::comma(constituents)),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(
  head(potential_organization_records, 20),
  format = "pipe",
  caption = "First 20 potential organization records for review"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: individual-versus-organization-giving-checks

organization_panel <- potential_organization_records |>
  select(constituent_id) |>
  inner_join(donor_fiscal_year_panel, by = "constituent_id")

potential_organization_fy_summary <- organization_panel |>
  group_by(fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    potential_organization_constituents = n_distinct(constituent_id),
    potential_organizations_with_positive_giving = sum(gave_this_year),
    total_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving, na.rm = TRUE),
    major_donors = sum(is_major_donor),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(fiscal_year)

donor_fiscal_year_entity_comparison <- donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  mutate(
    entity_group = if_else(
      constituent_id %in% potential_organization_records$constituent_id,
      "Potential organizations",
      "All other eligible constituents"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(entity_group) |>
  summarise(
    donor_fiscal_year_records = n(),
    distinct_constituents = n_distinct(constituent_id),
    donor_years_with_positive_giving = sum(gave_this_year),
    total_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving, na.rm = TRUE),
    major_donor_years = sum(is_major_donor),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(
  potential_organization_fy_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(potential_organization_constituents,
               potential_organizations_with_positive_giving, major_donors),
             scales::comma),
      total_annual_giving = scales::dollar(total_annual_giving)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(
  donor_fiscal_year_entity_comparison |>
    mutate(
      across(c(donor_fiscal_year_records, distinct_constituents,
               donor_years_with_positive_giving, major_donor_years),
             scales::comma),
      total_annual_giving = scales::dollar(total_annual_giving)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

Exactly two constituents are explicitly classified as `Organization` in both
available type fields. Because this project ranks individual major-donor
prospects, these two records will be excluded from the final modeling panel.
The original Section 6B charts and summaries include these two organizations
and are retained as the pre-exclusion view.

```{r}
#| label: organization-exclusion-modeling-panel

organization_constituents <- constituents_analysis |>
  filter(
    primary_constituent_type == "Organization" |
      str_detect(
        coalesce(as.character(constituent_type), ""),
        regex("Organization", ignore_case = TRUE)
      )
  ) |>
  select(constituent_id, primary_constituent_type, constituent_type)

modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel <- donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  filter(!constituent_id %in% organization_constituents$constituent_id)

summarise_panel_group <- function(data, group_name) {
  tibble(
    group = group_name,
    distinct_constituents = n_distinct(data$constituent_id),
    donor_fiscal_year_rows = nrow(data),
    donor_years_with_positive_giving = sum(data$gave_this_year),
    total_annual_giving = sum(data$annual_giving, na.rm = TRUE),
    major_donor_years = sum(data$is_major_donor)
  )
}

excluded_organization_panel <- donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  filter(constituent_id %in% organization_constituents$constituent_id)

organization_exclusion_audit <- bind_rows(
  summarise_panel_group(donor_fiscal_year_panel,
                        "All eligible constituent records"),
  summarise_panel_group(excluded_organization_panel,
                        "Excluded organization records"),
  summarise_panel_group(modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel,
                        "Remaining individual constituent records")
)

knitr::kable(
  organization_exclusion_audit |>
    mutate(
      across(c(distinct_constituents, donor_fiscal_year_rows,
               donor_years_with_positive_giving, major_donor_years),
             scales::comma),
      total_annual_giving = scales::dollar(total_annual_giving)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

All future conversion-target and predictor analyses will use `modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel`.

### Time-aware eligible donor panel

A donor can enter the historical modeling population only after their first
positive, linked PBS Utah gift. Including a person before that first gift would
use future information and create data leakage.

```{r}
#| label: time-aware-eligible-donor-panel

first_giving_year <- donor_fiscal_year_giving |>
  filter(annual_giving > 0) |>
  mutate(fiscal_year_number = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(fiscal_year, "FY"))) |>
  group_by(constituent_id) |>
  summarise(first_giving_year = min(fiscal_year_number), .groups = "drop")

modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel <- donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  filter(!constituent_id %in% organization_constituents$constituent_id) |>
  mutate(fiscal_year_number = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(fiscal_year, "FY"))) |>
  left_join(first_giving_year, by = "constituent_id") |>
  filter(fiscal_year_number >= first_giving_year) |>
  select(-fiscal_year_number)

time_aware_individual_panel_summary <- modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  group_by(fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    eligible_donors = n_distinct(constituent_id),
    donors_who_gave = sum(gave_this_year),
    major_donors = sum(is_major_donor),
    major_donor_percentage = major_donors / eligible_donors,
    total_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving, na.rm = TRUE),
    major_donor_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving[is_major_donor], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(fiscal_year)

knitr::kable(
  time_aware_individual_panel_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(eligible_donors, donors_who_gave, major_donors), scales::comma),
      major_donor_percentage = scales::percent(major_donor_percentage,
                                                accuracy = 0.1),
      across(c(total_annual_giving, major_donor_annual_giving), scales::dollar)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

This time-aware individual panel will be used to create future conversion labels in Section 7.

### Legacy giving linkage check

Legacy payments are household-level and can link to up to seven constituents.
Before using them for historical donor eligibility or features, the analysis
must determine how often a gift links to one person versus multiple people.

```{r}
#| label: legacy-giving-linkage-check

legacy_id_columns <- paste0("constituent_id_", 1:7)

legacy_link_matrix <- legacy_payments_analysis |>
  select(all_of(legacy_id_columns)) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) |>
  as.matrix()

legacy_link_present <- !is.na(legacy_link_matrix) &
  trimws(legacy_link_matrix) != ""
legacy_link_count <- rowSums(legacy_link_present)

legacy_linkage_summary <- tibble(
  linkage_group = case_when(
    legacy_link_count == 0 ~ "Zero linked constituents",
    legacy_link_count == 1 ~ "Exactly one linked constituent",
    legacy_link_count == 2 ~ "Two linked constituents",
    legacy_link_count >= 3 ~ "Three or more linked constituents"
  )
) |>
  count(linkage_group, name = "legacy_rows") |>
  mutate(percentage = legacy_rows / sum(legacy_rows)) |>
  arrange(factor(
    linkage_group,
    levels = c(
      "Zero linked constituents", "Exactly one linked constituent",
      "Two linked constituents", "Three or more linked constituents"
    )
  ))

legacy_position_summary <- tibble(
  linked_id_position = colnames(legacy_link_matrix),
  populated_rows = colSums(legacy_link_present),
  percentage_of_legacy_rows = populated_rows / nrow(legacy_link_matrix)
)

legacy_link_ids <- legacy_link_matrix[legacy_link_present]
constituent_ids <- as.character(constituents_analysis$constituent_id)
legacy_link_match_summary <- tibble(
  nonmissing_legacy_constituent_ids = length(legacy_link_ids),
  unmatched_legacy_constituent_ids = sum(!legacy_link_ids %in% constituent_ids),
  all_nonmissing_ids_match = all(legacy_link_ids %in% constituent_ids)
)

two_person_linkage_patterns <- tibble(
  linked_constituent_count = legacy_link_count,
  linkage_pattern = apply(
    legacy_link_present,
    1,
    function(position_present) {
      paste(colnames(legacy_link_matrix)[position_present], collapse = " + ")
    }
  )
) |>
  filter(linked_constituent_count == 2) |>
  count(linkage_pattern, name = "legacy_rows") |>
  arrange(desc(legacy_rows))

knitr::kable(
  legacy_linkage_summary |>
    mutate(legacy_rows = scales::comma(legacy_rows),
           percentage = scales::percent(percentage, accuracy = 0.1)),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(
  legacy_position_summary |>
    mutate(populated_rows = scales::comma(populated_rows),
           percentage_of_legacy_rows = scales::percent(
             percentage_of_legacy_rows,
             accuracy = 0.1
           )),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(legacy_link_match_summary, format = "pipe")
knitr::kable(two_person_linkage_patterns, format = "pipe")
```

The next step will document an allocation rule for usable legacy history.

### Legacy history allocation rule

Legacy payments are household-level. For individual-level historical context,
each record with a non-missing `constituent_id_1` is assigned to that primary
linked constituent. Records with no linked constituent are excluded from
individual history. When a secondary linked constituent exists, the payment is
still assigned only to the primary ID to avoid double counting; this is a
documented limitation.

```{r}
#| label: legacy-history-allocation

legacy_individual_history <- legacy_payments_analysis |>
  filter(!is.na(constituent_id_1), trimws(as.character(constituent_id_1)) != "") |>
  transmute(
    constituent_id = as.character(constituent_id_1),
    legacy_fiscal_year = paste0("FY", fiscal_year_from_date(gift_date)),
    gift_date,
    payment_amount,
    multiple_linked_constituents = !is.na(constituent_id_2) &
      trimws(as.character(constituent_id_2)) != ""
  )

legacy_no_linked_constituent_rows <- sum(legacy_link_count == 0)

legacy_history_audit <- tibble(
  metric = c(
    "Total legacy rows",
    "Rows excluded because no constituent is linked",
    "Rows assigned to a primary constituent",
    "Rows with multiple linked constituents",
    "Total legacy dollars assigned to primary constituent history"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(legacy_payments_analysis),
    legacy_no_linked_constituent_rows,
    nrow(legacy_individual_history),
    sum(legacy_individual_history$multiple_linked_constituents),
    sum(legacy_individual_history$payment_amount, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

legacy_donor_summary <- legacy_individual_history |>
  group_by(constituent_id) |>
  summarise(
    first_legacy_gift_date = min(gift_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_legacy_gift_date = max(gift_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    lifetime_legacy_giving = sum(payment_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    legacy_gift_count = n(),
    multiple_linked_constituents = any(multiple_linked_constituents),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(
  legacy_history_audit |>
    mutate(value = if_else(
      metric == "Total legacy dollars assigned to primary constituent history",
      scales::dollar(value),
      scales::comma(value)
    )),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

Legacy history will be used as prior context when finalizing the time-aware donor population and later features.

### Final time-aware individual donor panel

Eligibility now uses the earliest linked gift in either legacy history or
FY2021–FY2026 giving history. A donor is eligible in a fiscal year only if
their first known linked gift occurred on or before that fiscal year's June 30
end date.

```{r}
#| label: final-time-aware-individual-panel

combined_donor_history <- bind_rows(
  legacy_individual_history |>
    transmute(constituent_id, gift_date, history_source = "legacy"),
  constituent_giving_transactions |>
    transmute(
      constituent_id,
      gift_date = gift_credit_date,
      history_source = source
    )
)

first_known_gift <- combined_donor_history |>
  group_by(constituent_id) |>
  summarise(first_known_gift_date = min(gift_date, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

modeling_fiscal_years <- donor_fiscal_year_giving |>
  distinct(fiscal_year) |>
  mutate(
    fiscal_year_number = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(fiscal_year, "FY")),
    fiscal_year_end_date = as.Date(paste0(fiscal_year_number, "-06-30"))
  ) |>
  arrange(fiscal_year)

modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  constituent_id = setdiff(
    first_known_gift$constituent_id,
    organization_constituents$constituent_id
  ),
  modeling_fiscal_years
) |>
  left_join(first_known_gift, by = "constituent_id") |>
  filter(first_known_gift_date <= fiscal_year_end_date) |>
  left_join(donor_fiscal_year_giving, by = c("constituent_id", "fiscal_year")) |>
  mutate(
    annual_giving = replace_na(annual_giving, 0),
    direct_payment_dollars = replace_na(direct_payment_dollars, 0),
    soft_credit_dollars = replace_na(soft_credit_dollars, 0),
    direct_payment_count = replace_na(direct_payment_count, 0L),
    soft_credit_count = replace_na(soft_credit_count, 0L),
    largest_gift = replace_na(largest_gift, 0),
    gave_this_year = annual_giving > 0,
    is_major_donor = annual_giving >= 1200,
    giving_tier = case_when(
      annual_giving == 0 ~ "No giving",
      annual_giving < 1200 ~ "Under $1,200",
      annual_giving < 2000 ~ "$1,200–$1,999",
      annual_giving < 5000 ~ "$2,000–$4,999",
      annual_giving < 10000 ~ "$5,000–$9,999",
      annual_giving < 15000 ~ "$10,000–$14,999",
      TRUE ~ "$15,000+"
    ),
    giving_tier = factor(
      giving_tier,
      levels = c(
        "No giving", "Under $1,200", "$1,200–$1,999", "$2,000–$4,999",
        "$5,000–$9,999", "$10,000–$14,999", "$15,000+"
      )
    )
  )

final_time_aware_panel_summary <- modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  group_by(fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    eligible_donors = n_distinct(constituent_id),
    donors_who_gave = sum(gave_this_year),
    major_donors = sum(is_major_donor),
    major_donor_percentage = major_donors / eligible_donors,
    total_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving, na.rm = TRUE),
    major_donor_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving[is_major_donor], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(fiscal_year)

knitr::kable(
  final_time_aware_panel_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(eligible_donors, donors_who_gave, major_donors), scales::comma),
      major_donor_percentage = scales::percent(major_donor_percentage,
                                                accuracy = 0.1),
      across(c(total_annual_giving, major_donor_annual_giving), scales::dollar)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: final-time-aware-panel-audit

legacy_history_donors <- legacy_individual_history |>
  distinct(constituent_id) |>
  mutate(has_legacy_history = TRUE)

current_history_donors <- constituent_giving_transactions |>
  distinct(constituent_id) |>
  mutate(has_current_history = TRUE)

history_source_audit <- full_join(
  legacy_history_donors,
  current_history_donors,
  by = "constituent_id"
) |>
  filter(!constituent_id %in% organization_constituents$constituent_id) |>
  mutate(
    history_group = case_when(
      has_legacy_history & !is.na(has_current_history) ~ "Donors with both histories",
      has_legacy_history ~ "Donors with only legacy history",
      TRUE ~ "Donors with only FY2021–FY2026 history"
    )
  ) |>
  count(history_group, name = "donors")

final_time_aware_panel_audit <- bind_rows(
  history_source_audit |>
    transmute(metric = history_group, value = donors),
  tibble(
    metric = "Final individual donors included in the panel",
    value = n_distinct(modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel$constituent_id)
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  final_time_aware_panel_audit |>
    mutate(value = scales::comma(value)),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

## 7. Target-variable EDA

### Twelve-month major-donor conversion

At the end of each fiscal year, an eligible individual who is not already a
major donor is labeled as a 12-month converter if their annual giving reaches
at least $1,200 in the following fiscal year. Former major donors who are below
$1,200 at the snapshot date remain eligible, because the scope excludes current
major donors rather than all people who were ever major donors.

```{r}
#| label: twelve-month-major-donor-conversion

snapshot_years <- paste0("FY", 2021:2025)

following_year_outcomes <- modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  mutate(
    fiscal_year_number = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(fiscal_year, "FY")),
    snapshot_fiscal_year = paste0("FY", fiscal_year_number - 1)
  ) |>
  transmute(
    constituent_id,
    snapshot_fiscal_year,
    following_year_annual_giving = annual_giving,
    following_year_is_major_donor = is_major_donor
  )

conversion_12m_panel <- modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  filter(fiscal_year %in% snapshot_years, !is_major_donor) |>
  transmute(
    constituent_id,
    snapshot_fiscal_year = fiscal_year,
    snapshot_annual_giving = annual_giving
  ) |>
  left_join(
    following_year_outcomes,
    by = c("constituent_id", "snapshot_fiscal_year")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    converts_to_major_next_fy = following_year_annual_giving >= 1200
  )

conversion_12m_summary <- conversion_12m_panel |>
  group_by(snapshot_fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    eligible_non_major_donors = n(),
    twelve_month_converters = sum(converts_to_major_next_fy, na.rm = TRUE),
    conversion_rate = mean(converts_to_major_next_fy, na.rm = TRUE),
    majority_class_baseline_accuracy = 1 - conversion_rate,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(snapshot_fiscal_year)

conversion_12m_overall_summary <- conversion_12m_panel |>
  summarise(
    eligible_non_major_donors = n(),
    twelve_month_converters = sum(converts_to_major_next_fy, na.rm = TRUE),
    conversion_rate = mean(converts_to_major_next_fy, na.rm = TRUE),
    majority_class_baseline_accuracy = 1 - conversion_rate
  )

knitr::kable(
  conversion_12m_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(eligible_non_major_donors, twelve_month_converters),
             scales::comma),
      across(c(conversion_rate, majority_class_baseline_accuracy),
             scales::percent, accuracy = 0.001)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(
  conversion_12m_overall_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(eligible_non_major_donors, twelve_month_converters),
             scales::comma),
      across(c(conversion_rate, majority_class_baseline_accuracy),
             scales::percent, accuracy = 0.001)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: twelve-month-conversion-rate-plot

ggplot(conversion_12m_summary,
       aes(x = snapshot_fiscal_year, y = conversion_rate)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.001)) +
  labs(
    title = "Twelve-month major-donor conversion rate by snapshot fiscal year",
    x = "Snapshot fiscal year",
    y = "12-month conversion rate"
  )
```

Twelve-month conversion is a rare outcome, so majority-class accuracy is not a useful measure of prospect-ranking quality.

### Three- and five-year major-donor conversion

A donor is a longer-term converter if they are not a major donor at the
snapshot date but reach at least $1,200 in annual giving in any future fiscal
year within the stated horizon. Complete 3-year follow-up is available for
FY2021–FY2023, while complete 5-year follow-up is available only for FY2021.
Therefore, the 3-year target can be explored across multiple years, but the
5-year result is descriptive rather than a robust model-validation sample.

```{r}
#| label: three-and-five-year-conversion

modeling_panel_with_year_number <- modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  mutate(fiscal_year_number = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(fiscal_year, "FY")))

conversion_3y_panel <- modeling_panel_with_year_number |>
  filter(fiscal_year_number %in% 2021:2023, !is_major_donor) |>
  transmute(
    constituent_id,
    snapshot_fiscal_year = fiscal_year,
    snapshot_year_number = fiscal_year_number
  ) |>
  left_join(
    modeling_panel_with_year_number |>
      transmute(
        constituent_id,
        future_year_number = fiscal_year_number,
        future_annual_giving = annual_giving
      ),
    by = "constituent_id",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  filter(
    future_year_number > snapshot_year_number,
    future_year_number <= snapshot_year_number + 3
  ) |>
  group_by(constituent_id, snapshot_fiscal_year, snapshot_year_number) |>
  summarise(
    converts_to_major_within_3y = any(future_annual_giving >= 1200),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

conversion_3y_summary <- conversion_3y_panel |>
  group_by(snapshot_fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    eligible_non_major_donors = n(),
    three_year_converters = sum(converts_to_major_within_3y),
    conversion_rate = mean(converts_to_major_within_3y),
    majority_class_baseline_accuracy = 1 - conversion_rate,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(snapshot_fiscal_year)

conversion_3y_overall_summary <- conversion_3y_panel |>
  summarise(
    eligible_non_major_donors = n(),
    three_year_converters = sum(converts_to_major_within_3y),
    conversion_rate = mean(converts_to_major_within_3y),
    majority_class_baseline_accuracy = 1 - conversion_rate
  )

conversion_5y_fy2021_summary <- modeling_panel_with_year_number |>
  filter(fiscal_year_number == 2021, !is_major_donor) |>
  transmute(constituent_id) |>
  left_join(
    modeling_panel_with_year_number |>
      filter(fiscal_year_number %in% 2022:2026) |>
      group_by(constituent_id) |>
      summarise(
        becomes_major_within_5y = any(annual_giving >= 1200),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "constituent_id"
  ) |>
  summarise(
    eligible_non_major_donors_fy2021 = n(),
    five_year_converters = sum(becomes_major_within_5y, na.rm = TRUE),
    five_year_conversion_rate = five_year_converters /
      eligible_non_major_donors_fy2021
  )

knitr::kable(
  conversion_3y_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(eligible_non_major_donors, three_year_converters), scales::comma),
      across(c(conversion_rate, majority_class_baseline_accuracy),
             scales::percent, accuracy = 0.001)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(
  conversion_3y_overall_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(eligible_non_major_donors, three_year_converters), scales::comma),
      across(c(conversion_rate, majority_class_baseline_accuracy),
             scales::percent, accuracy = 0.001)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(
  conversion_5y_fy2021_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(eligible_non_major_donors_fy2021, five_year_converters),
             scales::comma),
      five_year_conversion_rate = scales::percent(
        five_year_conversion_rate,
        accuracy = 0.001
      )
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

## 8. Predictor EDA

## Giving-history features

Every predictor must use information available on or before the snapshot fiscal-year end date. Future giving must never be used to predict conversion. These features use only individual-level legacy and current giving transactions dated by each donor-year snapshot.

```{r}
# Build RFM features efficiently from donor × fiscal-year summaries.
# All snapshots occur at the end of a PBS Utah fiscal year (June 30).

candidate_base <- conversion_12m_panel |>
  mutate(
    snapshot_year_number = as.integer(str_remove(snapshot_fiscal_year, "FY")),
    snapshot_end_date = as.Date(paste0(snapshot_year_number, "-06-30"))
  )

candidate_ids <- candidate_base |>
  distinct(constituent_id)

# Aggregate raw gift history once, rather than once for every donor-year row.
history_by_fiscal_year <- giving_history_transactions |>
  semi_join(candidate_ids, by = "constituent_id") |>
  filter(!is.na(gift_date), !is.na(amount)) |>
  mutate(
    gift_fiscal_year_number = as.integer(
      str_remove(gift_fiscal_year, "FY")
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(constituent_id, gift_fiscal_year_number) |>
  summarise(
    fiscal_year_giving = sum(amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    fiscal_year_gift_count = n(),
    fiscal_year_largest_gift = max(amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_gift_date_in_fy = min(gift_date),
    last_gift_date_in_fy = max(gift_date),
    legacy_giving_in_fy = any(source == "legacy"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Build one feature table per snapshot year, then combine them.
rfm_runtime <- system.time({

  rfm_predictor_eda <- map_dfr(
    sort(unique(candidate_base$snapshot_year_number)),
    function(snapshot_year_number) {

      snapshot_candidates <- candidate_base |>
        filter(snapshot_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number)

      # This table is already aggregated to donor × fiscal year.
      # It is much smaller than raw transaction history.
      history_to_snapshot <- history_by_fiscal_year |>
        filter(gift_fiscal_year_number <= .env$snapshot_year_number) |>
        group_by(constituent_id) |>
        summarise(
          giving_last_12m = sum(
            fiscal_year_giving[
              gift_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number
            ],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          giving_last_36m = sum(
            fiscal_year_giving[
              gift_fiscal_year_number >= .env$snapshot_year_number - 2
            ],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          gift_count_last_12m = sum(
            fiscal_year_gift_count[
              gift_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number
            ],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          lifetime_giving_to_date = sum(fiscal_year_giving, na.rm = TRUE),
          lifetime_gift_count = sum(fiscal_year_gift_count, na.rm = TRUE),
          largest_prior_gift = max(fiscal_year_largest_gift, na.rm = TRUE),
          first_known_gift_date = min(first_gift_date_in_fy),
          last_known_gift_date = max(last_gift_date_in_fy),
          had_legacy_giving_history = any(legacy_giving_in_fy),
          gave_in_snapshot_year = any(
            gift_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number
          ),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      snapshot_candidates |>
        left_join(history_to_snapshot, by = "constituent_id") |>
        mutate(
          giving_last_12m = replace_na(giving_last_12m, 0),
          giving_last_36m = replace_na(giving_last_36m, 0),
          gift_count_last_12m = replace_na(gift_count_last_12m, 0L),
          lifetime_giving_to_date = replace_na(lifetime_giving_to_date, 0),
          lifetime_gift_count = replace_na(lifetime_gift_count, 0L),
          largest_prior_gift = replace_na(largest_prior_gift, 0),
          gave_in_snapshot_year = replace_na(gave_in_snapshot_year, FALSE),
          had_legacy_giving_history = replace_na(
            had_legacy_giving_history, FALSE
          ),
          months_since_last_gift = if_else(
            !is.na(last_known_gift_date),
            interval(last_known_gift_date, snapshot_end_date) %/% months(1),
            NA_integer_
          ),
          donor_tenure_years = if_else(
            !is.na(first_known_gift_date),
            time_length(
              interval(first_known_gift_date, snapshot_end_date),
              "years"
            ),
            NA_real_
          )
        ) |>
        select(-first_known_gift_date, -last_known_gift_date)
    }
  )
})

rfm_runtime

# Validation: these must match the target panel exactly.
stopifnot(nrow(rfm_predictor_eda) == nrow(conversion_12m_panel))

rfm_duplicate_keys <- rfm_predictor_eda |>
  count(constituent_id, snapshot_fiscal_year) |>
  filter(n > 1)

stopifnot(nrow(rfm_duplicate_keys) == 0)
```

```{r}
# Compare distributions by outcome; these are associations, not causal effects.
predictor_comparison <- rfm_predictor_eda |>
  group_by(converts_to_major_next_fy) |>
  summarise(across(c(giving_last_12m, giving_last_36m, lifetime_giving_to_date, largest_prior_gift, months_since_last_gift, donor_tenure_years),
    list(median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), iqr = ~IQR(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .names = "{.col}__{.fn}"), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_longer(-converts_to_major_next_fy, names_to = c("feature", "statistic"), names_sep = "__") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = statistic, values_from = value) |>
  mutate(converts_to_major_next_fy = if_else(converts_to_major_next_fy, "Future converter", "Did not convert"))
knitr::kable(predictor_comparison, digits = 2, caption = "Giving-history features by 12-month conversion status")
```

```{r}
# Visual comparisons are descriptive associations, not causal effects.
ggplot(filter(rfm_predictor_eda, giving_last_12m > 0), aes(factor(converts_to_major_next_fy), giving_last_12m)) +
  geom_boxplot() + scale_y_log10() + labs(title = "Last-12-month giving by future-converter status", subtitle = "Descriptive association, not a causal effect", x = "Future converter", y = "Giving (log scale)")
ggplot(filter(rfm_predictor_eda, largest_prior_gift > 0), aes(factor(converts_to_major_next_fy), largest_prior_gift)) +
  geom_boxplot() + scale_y_log10() + labs(title = "Largest prior gift by future-converter status", subtitle = "Descriptive association, not a causal effect", x = "Future converter", y = "Largest gift (log scale)")
ggplot(rfm_predictor_eda, aes(factor(converts_to_major_next_fy), months_since_last_gift)) +
  geom_boxplot(na.rm = TRUE) + labs(title = "Months since last gift by future-converter status", subtitle = "Descriptive association, not a causal effect", x = "Future converter", y = "Months since last gift")
```


## Campaign-history features

Campaign history may reflect both donor engagement and staff targeting. The summaries below are therefore descriptive associations, not evidence that a campaign caused a future major gift.

```{r}
# Build campaign features efficiently from constituent × fiscal-year summaries.
# Do not join raw campaign records to the donor-year target panel.

candidate_base <- conversion_12m_panel |>
  mutate(
    snapshot_year_number = as.integer(str_remove(snapshot_fiscal_year, "FY")),
    snapshot_end_date = as.Date(paste0(snapshot_year_number, "-06-30"))
  )

candidate_ids <- candidate_base |>
  distinct(constituent_id)

# Keep only columns needed for campaign features and only relevant constituents.
campaign_history_small <- campaign_members_analysis |>
  select(constituent_id, marketing_code, campaign_start_date, responded_date) |>
  semi_join(candidate_ids, by = "constituent_id") |>
  left_join(
    campaign_codes_analysis |>
      select(marketing_code, communication_method),
    by = "marketing_code"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    campaign_start_date = as.Date(campaign_start_date),
    responded_date = as.Date(responded_date),
    campaign_fy_number = fiscal_year_from_date(campaign_start_date),
    response_fy_number = fiscal_year_from_date(responded_date)
  )

# Aggregate solicitations once by constituent and fiscal year.
campaign_by_fiscal_year <- campaign_history_small |>
  filter(!is.na(campaign_start_date)) |>
  arrange(constituent_id, campaign_start_date, marketing_code) |>
  group_by(constituent_id, campaign_fy_number) |>
  summarise(
    fiscal_year_solicitations = n(),
    communication_method_in_fy = last(
      communication_method[!is.na(communication_method)],
      default = NA_character_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Aggregate responses once by response fiscal year.
# Response timing, not campaign-start timing, determines whether it was known.
responses_by_fiscal_year <- campaign_history_small |>
  filter(!is.na(responded_date)) |>
  group_by(constituent_id, response_fy_number) |>
  summarise(
    fiscal_year_responses = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

campaign_runtime <- system.time({

  campaign_features <- map_dfr(
    sort(unique(candidate_base$snapshot_year_number)),
    function(snapshot_year_number) {

      candidates <- candidate_base |>
        filter(snapshot_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number)

      solicitation_summary <- campaign_by_fiscal_year |>
        filter(campaign_fy_number <= .env$snapshot_year_number) |>
        group_by(constituent_id) |>
        summarise(
          solicitations_last_12m = sum(
            fiscal_year_solicitations[
              campaign_fy_number == .env$snapshot_year_number
            ],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          solicitations_last_36m = sum(
            fiscal_year_solicitations[
              campaign_fy_number >= .env$snapshot_year_number - 2
            ],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          lifetime_solicitations = sum(fiscal_year_solicitations, na.rm = TRUE),
          most_recent_communication_method = last(
            communication_method_in_fy[
              !is.na(communication_method_in_fy)
            ],
            default = NA_character_
          ),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      response_summary <- responses_by_fiscal_year |>
        filter(response_fy_number <= .env$snapshot_year_number) |>
        group_by(constituent_id) |>
        summarise(
          campaign_responses_last_12m = sum(
            fiscal_year_responses[
              response_fy_number == .env$snapshot_year_number
            ],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          lifetime_campaign_responses = sum(
            fiscal_year_responses,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      candidates |>
        left_join(solicitation_summary, by = "constituent_id") |>
        left_join(response_summary, by = "constituent_id") |>
        mutate(
          solicitations_last_12m = replace_na(
            solicitations_last_12m, 0L
          ),
          solicitations_last_36m = replace_na(
            solicitations_last_36m, 0L
          ),
          lifetime_solicitations = replace_na(
            lifetime_solicitations, 0L
          ),
          campaign_responses_last_12m = replace_na(
            campaign_responses_last_12m, 0L
          ),
          lifetime_campaign_responses = replace_na(
            lifetime_campaign_responses, 0L
          ),
          lifetime_campaign_response_rate = if_else(
            lifetime_solicitations > 0,
            lifetime_campaign_responses / lifetime_solicitations,
            NA_real_
          ),
          responded_to_any_campaign_last_12m =
            campaign_responses_last_12m > 0
        )
    }
  )
})

campaign_runtime

# Validation checks
stopifnot(nrow(campaign_features) == nrow(conversion_12m_panel))

campaign_duplicate_keys <- campaign_features |>
  count(constituent_id, snapshot_fiscal_year) |>
  filter(n > 1)

stopifnot(nrow(campaign_duplicate_keys) == 0)
```

```{r}
  group_by(converts_to_major_next_fy) |>
  summarise(
    median_solicitations_last_12m = median(solicitations_last_12m, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_responding_last_12m = mean(responded_to_any_campaign_last_12m, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_campaign_responses_to_date = median(lifetime_campaign_responses, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lifetime_response_rate = median(lifetime_campaign_response_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(across(c(pct_responding_last_12m, median_lifetime_response_rate), ~scales::percent(.x, accuracy = 0.1)),
         converts_to_major_next_fy = if_else(converts_to_major_next_fy, "Future converter", "Did not convert"))
knitr::kable(campaign_comparison, caption = "Campaign history by 12-month conversion status")
```

```{r}
    ),
```

## Passport viewing features

Passport data is available only for linked or consenting viewing records. A missing Passport record does not mean that a donor did not engage with PBS Utah, so coverage is reported separately from viewing behavior. These results assess incremental association rather than complete audience engagement.

```{r}
# Build Passport features efficiently from constituent × fiscal-year summaries.
# Missing Passport data remains missing; it is not converted to zero viewing.

candidate_base <- conversion_12m_panel |>
  mutate(
    snapshot_year_number = as.integer(str_remove(snapshot_fiscal_year, "FY"))
  )

candidate_ids <- candidate_base |>
  distinct(constituent_id)

passport_by_fiscal_year <- passport_viewing_analysis |>
  semi_join(candidate_ids, by = "constituent_id") |>
  mutate(
    passport_fiscal_year_number = as.integer(
      str_remove(as.character(fiscal_year), "FY")
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(constituent_id, passport_fiscal_year_number) |>
  summarise(
    fiscal_year_titles_viewed = sum(titles_viewed, na.rm = TRUE),
    fiscal_year_distinct_genres = n_distinct(genre),
    fiscal_year_mean_percent_watched = mean(
      mean_percent_watched,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

passport_runtime <- system.time({

  passport_features <- map_dfr(
    sort(unique(candidate_base$snapshot_year_number)),
    function(snapshot_year_number) {

      candidates <- candidate_base |>
        filter(snapshot_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number)

      passport_summary <- passport_by_fiscal_year |>
        filter(passport_fiscal_year_number <= .env$snapshot_year_number) |>
        group_by(constituent_id) |>
        summarise(
          passport_record_available = TRUE,
          titles_viewed_last_12m = if_else(
            any(passport_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number),
            sum(
              fiscal_year_titles_viewed[
                passport_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number
              ],
              na.rm = TRUE
            ),
            NA_real_
          ),
          titles_viewed_last_36m = if_else(
            any(
              passport_fiscal_year_number >=
                .env$snapshot_year_number - 2
            ),
            sum(
              fiscal_year_titles_viewed[
                passport_fiscal_year_number >=
                  .env$snapshot_year_number - 2
              ],
              na.rm = TRUE
            ),
            NA_real_
          ),
          distinct_genres_last_12m = if_else(
            any(passport_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number),
            sum(
              fiscal_year_distinct_genres[
                passport_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number
              ],
              na.rm = TRUE
            ),
            NA_integer_
          ),
          mean_percent_watched_last_12m = if_else(
            any(passport_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number),
            mean(
              fiscal_year_mean_percent_watched[
                passport_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number
              ],
              na.rm = TRUE
            ),
            NA_real_
          ),
          passport_viewing_recency_years = .env$snapshot_year_number -
            max(passport_fiscal_year_number),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      candidates |>
        left_join(passport_summary, by = "constituent_id") |>
        mutate(
          passport_record_available = replace_na(
            passport_record_available,
            FALSE
          )
        )
    }
  )
})

passport_runtime

# Validation checks
stopifnot(nrow(passport_features) == nrow(conversion_12m_panel))

passport_duplicate_keys <- passport_features |>
  count(constituent_id, snapshot_fiscal_year) |>
  filter(n > 1)

stopifnot(nrow(passport_duplicate_keys) == 0)
```
